protocol.bothActors: AI normal, actual AI2Class:AI; same weapon on both sides; original default looks/health/combat
protocol.wounds: actual combat only, no injection, suppression, freezing, manual injury or parked actor
protocol.geometryCadence: anchor gaps every step; getup geometry120Hz, postinjury stand10Hz, state/injury events full snapshot

units.anchors: m; exact anchor1/2 body local coordinates transformed to world
units.lateral: m in actual pelvis rotation frame; includes movement of the frame
units.angular: rad/s child-parent angvel in parent frame
units.feet: floor solver contact, velocity m/s, pin residual m; pin flag is not immobility proof
